text:
Naveen: Heads-up 16: Launch plan for the paid stack tomorrow AM. Two parallel experiments: (1) search with price-anchor headlines, (2) retarget carousel driving webinar signups. Need final creatives + landing splits by EOD.

Claire: For search, I propose 3 anchor variants: "Starts at $X/month", "From $X/month", and "Try for $X". We'll A/B at ad-group level.

Ruth: For webinar gating, we should send 60% to gated LP (email capture) and 40% to ungated blog (SEO-friendly). Track MQL rate separately.

Dmitri: Budget ask: $1,800/day total. Allocate $1k to search experiment, $600 to retarget, $200 for exploratory branded bids. Ramp rules: +15% at T+6h, +15% at T+24h if CPA within target.

Naveen: CPA targets: search $35 CPL, retarget webinar $18 CPL. If landing conversion <2% after 12h revert creative.

Claire: Creative checklist: headlines, description lines (<=90 chars), price anchors, two stat overlays, and one social proof card (logo + short quote). I'll drop variants to Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/ads/price-anchor-expt

ads-bot: scheduler: Campaigns preflight running. Will post final go/no-go 30m before launch. Health hooks: /alerts/marketing/price-anchor and /alerts/marketing/webinar-flow.

Ruth: Inbound routing: Leads from gated LP -> Marketo list "PA_Webinar_Leads" with utm_source=paid&utm_campaign=price_anchor_expt. Non-gated blog leads -> nurture flow with content tracks.

Dmitri: Bidding config (JSON passed to API):
```
{
  "strategy": "maximize_conversions",
  "daily_budget": 1800,
  "pacing": [15,15],
  "alloc": {"search": 1000, "retarget": 600, "branded_explore": 200},
  "price_anchors": ["Starts at $99","From $99","Try for $99"]
}
```

Jules: Quick QA note: detection pixel currently strips utm_content on redirect. Please ensure we preserve utms or add server-side capture. Last month we lost ~12% attribution.

Claire: Will update tracking tags. Also adding creative-level utm_content: `creative_{{id}}_anchor{{variant}}`.

Naveen: One more: add a holdback for cohorts from last 30 days to avoid overlap with existing retargeting. Exclude list: previous_30d_purchase + previous_30d_webinar.

Ruth: Noted. Also recommend we surface a benchmark doc in the thread after 48h — baseline CTR/CPR for comparison.

ads-bot: preflight: all systems green except pixel-fallthrough flagged by Jules. Will re-run after Claire updates tags.

Claire: tag update pushed. Re-testing pixel now.

Dmitri: If CPA overshoots by >30% in any channel, auto-pause that channel and notify @Naveen @Claire.

Naveen: Good call. Ok team, final sync 7pm PT today. If green we go live tomorrow 9am PT. Thanks! :rocket:
